description: Sets the order of all properties on the selected wedding's guest site and accommodation screen. The complete list is required, as property ids from the places list or as names; name matching ignores case and surrounding spaces. Results and refusals give the order as ids with names. Partial or invalid lists are refused with the current order. Requires sign-in and an Aisle membership.

place_ids.description: Complete list of property ids from the selected wedding’s places list, in the intended display order. Provide this or place_names.

place_names.description: Complete list of property names in the selected wedding, in the intended display order. Provide this or place_ids.

wedding_id.description: Identifier of a wedding the signed-in account can manage. Required when the account has multiple weddings.

name: reorder_my_places
